scope: ART-01 arena and compact HUD only

approval.runtime: PENDING director review at normal gameplay zoom

sourceProcess: Separate original generated ground, props, garden, icons and blank UI frames. Named layers were explicitly reconstructed in Aseprite; original layers were not recovered from the flattened concept.

layout.navigation: Existing server map and spawn markers unchanged; only painted surfaces are adapted.

remainingPlaceholders: item-category icons and destination art outside ART-01
limitations: M1 has no statue collider/health or invasions; no authoritative geometry was changed.
Inventory/shop/dungeon/PvP are real existing preview overlays without the later-milestone backends.
M1 has no quick-item backend or skill ranks, so no potion counts or rank values are invented.
Banner is static; water and lantern loops are texture flow/glow, not a claimed hand-drawn full-fluid animation.
